source.citation: Märtens et al. 'Super-resolution of PROBA-V images using CNNs', Astrodynamics 3.4 (2019); PROBA-V Super-Resolution dataset, Zenodo 6327426.

layout_finding.imgset_id_scheme: continuous partitioned by band, NOT duplicated across bands
layout_finding.test_contents: LR###.png + QM###.png + SM.png (HR withheld per challenge)
layout_finding.implication: Dataset loaders must treat each imgset as belonging to ONE band; region-based splitting needed to avoid leakage between RED/NIR imgsets of the same region.

notes: 74 hand-selected regions; official split 1160 train / 290 test scenes
Per-scene: 9-19 LR images (300 m, 128x128), 1 HR image (100 m, 384x384)
Bands RED and NIR only; 14-bit radiometry stored in 16-bit PNG
Images NOT pre-registered; cPSNR metric is shift-invariant
